test_default_wmt_teacher: run pytest on the TestDefaultTeacher class to validate the default WMT task teacher in ParlAI
test_en_de_wmt_teacher: run pytest on the TestEnDeTeacher class to validate the WMT English-German task teacher in ParlAI
review_test_classes: review the TestDefaultTeacher and TestEnDeTeacher classes that extend AutoTeacherTest for WMT task validation
run_wmt_tests: run all WMT task teacher tests using pytest on the test module
